# 2 Baruch Chapter 76 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 76:2 — farewell formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "I-go to-my-fathers according-to-the-way-of-all-the-earth" |
| LOGOS | "I go to my fathers according to the way of all the earth" |
| PNEUMA | "I am going to join my fathers — that is the way of all living people" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'According to the way of all the earth' is a biblical formula for death (cf. Josh 23:14, 1 Kgs 2:2); LOGOS preserves the formal phrase which PNEUMA paraphrases.

---

## 76:4 — dual encouragement

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Be-not-afraid... do-not-be-anxious" |
| LOGOS | "Be not afraid... do not be anxious" |
| PNEUMA | "Do not be afraid... Do not be anxious" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. Minor variation only; LOGOS's archaic 'Be not afraid' preserves the prophetic address form better than PNEUMA's more modern phrasing.

---
